senses.gloss: वाध् वाध्, वाध वाध, see बाध्, बाध.

वध वध् + अ (also बध बध, probably better) m.
 1. Killing, Man. 5, 89; murder, Pañc. i. d. 305.
 2. Death, Man. 8, 104.
 3. Corporal punishment, Man. 9, 291.
 4. A stroke, 11, 100.
 5. A whip, 8, 267.
 6. Hurting, Man. 4, 165.
 7. A killer, a slaughterer, Man. 5, 39.
 --Comp.

वधक वध् + अक, also बधक,
 I. adj. Destructive, injurious.
 II. m. A murderer, Kathās. 3, 43.
वधत्र वध् + अत्र, n. A weapon.

वधु वधु (vb. वह्, q. cf.), f.
 1. A wife.
 2. A son's wife (cf. वधू).

वधू वधू, also बधू बधू (vb. वह्, q. cf.), f.
 1. A woman, Kirāt. 6, 45.
 2. A wife, Hit. i. d. 192, M.M.; Rām. 3, 51, 14; 55, 29.
 3. A wife recently married.
 4. A son's wife, Sāv. 6, 9.
 5. A female relation, Sund. 4, 16.
 6. The name of several plants.
 --Comp.
वाधू वाधू (vb. वह्, cf. वधु), f. A boat, a vessel.
वधुटी वधुटी, f. A son's wife.

वधूटी वधूटी, f.
 1. A son's wife.
 2. A young woman, living in her father's house, whether married or unmarried, Bhāṣāp. 1, a.
वधूयु वधूयु, i. e. वधूय, ved., + उ, adj. One who loves his wife, Lass. 99, 8 (where बधूयु) = Rigv. iii. 62, 8.

वध्यता वध्य + ता, or बध्यता बध्य + ता (from वध्, see हन्), f.
 1. Deserving death, Nal. 9, 8.
 2. Destruction.
वाधुक्य वाधुक्य, i. e. वधू̆ + क + य, n. Marriage.
